item.title: Nothing Phone (4a) release date announced in typically cheeky fashion
item.description: Nothing has announced the launch date for its next big mid-range smartphone release, the Nothing Phone (4a), in typically cheeky fashion. In the latest of a series of bold X posts from the company, Nothing CEO Carl Pei has posted an image of the recent 4 March Apple event invite – which could include the iPhone 17e – with the words “Nothing” and “5 March” crudely graffitied on top in bold pink paint. pic.twitter.com/W14DWrQ75P— Carl Pei (@getpeid) February 17, 2026 This warrants some unpacking.

item.title: How to watch Emerald Fennell’s Promising Young Woman and Saltburn free
item.description: The latest adaptation of Emily Brontë’s novel is causing a huge buzz, while dividing viewers into fans and staunch opponents of Emerald Fennell’s vision.
